basis.governing_question: How can MetalCo sell directly to small and mid-size contractors in Portugal and Spain through an online marketplace without losing its regional distributors?

phases.name: Design
phases.objective_one_line: Test the marketplace hypotheses and define the blueprint and pilot plan for contractors and regional distributors.

gate.label: Go/no-go on pilot
gate.decision: Does the blueprint justify starting the pilot in one region?

phases.name: Pilot
phases.objective_one_line: Launch a first marketplace version to contractors in one region and measure repeat orders and distributor retention.

gate.label: Pilot readout
gate.decision: Do the pilot results justify a rollout beyond the pilot region?

workstreams.name: Marketplace hypotheses
workstreams.answers: Which assumptions about contractors, distributors and the marketplace must hold for the pilot to work?
activities: Draft hypotheses for each blueprint component
Agree the evidence needed to test each hypothesis

deliverables.name: Hypotheses on each marketplace blueprint component

workstreams.name: Contractor demand evidence
workstreams.answers: What do small and mid-size contractors in Portugal and Spain need to order online directly from MetalCo?
activities: Interview contractors in Portugal and Spain
Review how large accounts use the B2B ordering portal
Test the hypotheses against contractor feedback

deliverables.name: Contractor needs and demand evidence on the hypotheses

workstreams.name: Distributor channel impact
workstreams.answers: How would direct online sales to contractors affect regional distributors, and what would keep them in the channel?
activities: Interview regional distributors and the distributors council
Map overlap of contractor accounts and distributors
Compare channel options with the distributors council

deliverables.name: Distributor impact assessment and channel options

workstreams.name: Pilot blueprint and plan
workstreams.answers: What does the marketplace blueprint look like once tested, and how will the pilot in one region run?
activities: Draft the blueprint from the tested hypotheses
Plan the pilot region, scope and milestones

deliverables.name: Detailed plan for the pilot in one region

workstreams.name: Stakeholder alignment
workstreams.answers: Which pilot KPIs and rules do MetalCo's leadership and the regional distributors council agree on?
activities: Agree pilot KPIs with CEO, Head of Sales and the council
Align sales teams and distributors on the pilot rules

deliverables.name: Pilot KPIs agreed with key stakeholders

workstreams.name: Pilot contractor group
workstreams.answers: Which contractors in the pilot region form the first target group for the marketplace?
activities: Select the pilot region contractor segment
Describe the first contractor target group

deliverables.name: First contractor target group in the pilot region

workstreams.name: Marketplace first version
workstreams.answers: Does a first marketplace version bring contractors in the pilot region to place repeat orders?
activities: Build the first marketplace version
Launch it to a small group of pilot contractors
Collect contractor and distributor feedback

deliverables.name: First marketplace version launched to pilot contractors

workstreams.name: Scale-up case and roadmap
workstreams.answers: Did the pilot meet both success criteria, and what would a rollout beyond the pilot region require?
activities: Compare pilot results with the success criteria
Draft the business case for the next step
Plan the rollout roadmap

deliverables.name: Pilot results against the two success criteria
Business case with rollout plan and roadmap

events.label: Kick-off
events.purpose: Align on scope, roles and the work plan
events.decision: Is the steering group aligned on scope, stakeholders and the Design timetable?
agenda: Confirm the governing question, scope and steering group roles
Review the work plan, phases and meeting calendar
Align on access to contractors and distributors for interviews

events.label: Design check-in
events.purpose: Check evidence so far and distributor views
events.decision: Does the evidence so far require a change of focus for the blueprint?
agenda: Present the contractor needs evidence and the tested hypotheses
Discuss early distributor views and open questions for the blueprint

events.label: Go/no-go on pilot
events.decision: Does the blueprint justify starting the pilot in one region?
agenda: Present the blueprint with tested hypotheses and the pilot plan
Review the distributor impact assessment and channel options
Decide whether to start the pilot

events.label: Workshop 1: first results
events.decision: Does the pilot keep its scope and target group for the remaining weeks?
agenda: Present the pilot contractor target group
Review progress of the first marketplace version and the pilot KPIs
Discuss early signals from contractors and distributors

events.label: Pilot readout
events.purpose: Decide on the step after the pilot
events.decision: Do the pilot results justify a rollout beyond the pilot region?
agenda: Present pilot results against the two success criteria
Review the business case, rollout plan and roadmap
Decide on the next step after the pilot

architect_notes: Not covered by the phases: European Commission, Construction Products Regulation digital product passports. Confirm whether it is in scope.
The 20-week total is stated but the stages are not, so the 6-week Design and 14-week Pilot split is my estimate from the archetype.
The marketplace is new, so the plan stops at the pilot; rollout beyond the pilot region is not in these phases.
Out of scope and deliverable format are unstated; confirm both before quoting, as they could change the Pilot deliverables and final decision pack.
